snippet.title: Hope Timbre Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
A public demo version of Hope Timbre available for everyone on Steam!

In Hope Timbre, you guide a mysterious creature through imaginary realm at night, or help two siblings awaken their broken world during the day.

In dreams, you traverse the colorful environments, manipulate the architecture to solve puzzles and find various hope instruments. These are musical instruments, songs, friendly creatures or pieces of a book.

After children wake up, they use them to heal themselves, grow their old tree, summon the spring and escape the never-ending cycle.

Key features of demo:
    • Unique type of puzzles utilizing full 3d space.
    • Collect hope instruments and songs to transform the cold world.
    • Decorate the world as it heals.
    • Non-linear game progression.
    • Controls are simple yet complex puzzles are possible.
    • Adaptive soundtrack - audio reflects actions in puzzle levels, while it adapts to overall game progression in real world.

Supported using public funding by Slovak arts council.
